thread:
elaine: Quick announcement — we're starting a phased removal of the legacy SDK compatibility shim (the `compat_layer` flag) to simplify runtime paths and unlock newer optimizations. Timeline and migration options below.

docs-bot: Migration guide live: https://redwood.internal/docs/sdk/migrate-compat — includes codemod and checklist.

kevin: timeline? any canary windows?

elaine: high level:
- June 15 — opt-in grace period: we set a soft deprecation banner in Console; `compat_layer` still works.
- July 15 — enforcement starts for new customers (fail-fast when `compat_layer` used in new orgs).
- Aug 30 — rolling removal: gradually reject `compat_layer` at the runtime layer for Hosted API.
- Sept 15 — full removal for Hosted API (Dedicated/private will follow a later schedule w/ support negotiation).

elaine: Canary plan: we will enable a canary cohort (5% traffic) that runs without the shim starting July 15. If perf/regressions are detected, we'll pause and notify.

maya: Is there copy we can put in the Console banner and email to customers?

elaine: Proposed banner: "Heads up: We're removing the SDK 'compat_layer' flag to improve latency and consistency. See migration steps in the SDK docs. Need extra help? Join office hours or contact support."

jonah: For brownfield customers with thousands of services, any codemod or automated checks?

docs-bot: Codemod tool: `rw-sdk-migrate --from compat_layer --to modern_api` (example). See repo: https://go/redwood/codemods/sdk-compat-migrate. Also added a `rw-sdk-check` linter rule that flags use of `compat_layer`.

sam: Support plan? We should block a few support engineers and schedule office hours.

elaine: Support: dedicated migration channel (#support-sdk-migrations) + 4 office hours slots (weekly, starting June 20). We'll staff with 2 SEs + 1 runtime engineer. I'll post calendar invites.

kevin: Rollback plan if things break?

elaine: Runtime fallback: requests can be routed to `model_variant=v1-compat` for a short grace period. Also will have feature-flagged rollback on the serving side for the canary. We'll publish rollback runbook in the migration guide.

jonah: Any telemetry we'll collect to validate correctness?

elaine: Yes — we'll collect latency histograms, token error rates, and diffs on top-10 prompt regression sets. Team will set regression alerts (>= 3% quality delta or >= 20ms p50 regression).

maya: Can marketing prep a customer-facing FAQ?

elaine: Yes — marketing + product to co-author. Draft due June 5. I'll share a template in #marketing.

kevin: Do we have a checklist for Dedicated/Private customers who can't take Hosted changes on this schedule?

docs-bot: Checklist stub added to guide: "Dedicated/Private: contact your AM, request a customized migration window, we will provide artifacts and a support SLA addendum."

sam: will post office hours link and support channel shortly.

maya: :thumbsup:

elaine: Thanks everyone — expect a short announcement email and Console banner on June 15. If you own a dependent repo, please run `rw-sdk-check` and file tickets with the `sdk-compat-migration` tag.
